feeds.title: The Halal Food Blog
feeds.description: The Halal Food Blog is your #1 guide for Halal food in Singapore and the region! Halal food is food that is prepared with minimal suffering to the animal and the pronouncement of God's name during the slaughter. The Quran, Islam's sacred book, is the source of halal.

feeds.title: Halal Food Hunt

feeds.title: Halal Girl About Town
feeds.description: Tired of eating the same typical halal food almost 10 years ago, Layla Hassanali made it her mission to find restaurants around London that both catered for halal and offered something a little different. What started as a 'blog' back in 2012 to journal all of the exciting new food and travel finds, HGAT has now evolved to become the UK's biggest halal food and travel platform dedicated to discovering the best halal restaurants in the country, Muslim-friendly travel destinations and more.

feeds.title: The Halal Eater
feeds.description: Halal food in Singapore. Cafes, restaurants, hawkers, food courts, pasar malams, and more. The Halal Eater blogs share Halal food news, dining guides, restaurant openings and human stories behind halal businesses in Singapore.

feeds.description: Thai Food Halal Blog loves sharing information and content regarding Thai food and Halal food in Thailand in general. That's why we decided to create a ThaiFoodHalal blog.

feeds.title: Halal Foodie Travel » Food
feeds.description: A big foodie and a keen traveler, I wanted to share some of my wonderful experience of travelling abroad as a Muslim woman in today's climate and some of my favourite foods from around the world.

feeds.title: Chef in disguise
feeds.description: Sawsan is the Chef in Disguise that shares easy authentic middle eastern recipes along with family favorites from around the globe. You will also get a taste of life in the middle east, the culture, and the famous landmarks.

feeds.title: Halal Xplorer » Food
feeds.description: At HalalXplorer, the focus is on providing readers and audiences with the finest discoveries worldwide in halal travel and food. The mission of HalalXplorer is to connect individuals with diverse travel destinations across the globe, showcasing that these experiences can be enjoyed in a halal manner. Featured destinations include Dubai, Turkey, Malaysia, Morocco, and Scotland, among others. The overarching goal is to inspire individuals to explore unique locations and provide them with resources to research, plan, book, and ultimately savour their dream vacations.
